verdict.reasons: Core defects: The main product (drip-tape carton roll) is displayed in isolation as a marketing display item rather than integrated into an operating irrigation system. The technical pressure evidence is severely flawed: the small black coiled hose acts as the pressure line and terminates on the ground in an impossible, non-functional loop with no plumbing connection or take-off fitting. Minor advisories: Generic neutral seedlings are present but lack the specified flat drip-lateral layout.

focused_physical_review.reason: A white strip/ribbon emerges from the bottom right of the AFP package. The black line from the pressure gauge touches the package immediately next to that white strip at the base.

acceptance_warnings: Independent physical condition not met: clear_soil_gap
Independent physical condition not met: line_touches_or_crosses_package
Independent physical condition not met: package_has_protruding_strip

acceptance_decision.source: user requested practical >=90 acceptance; actual saved vision evidence retained
